children: Sysco entered into a First Amendment to its Revolving Credit Agreement to add a $750 million senior unsecured delayed draw term loan facility. The CoBank Term Loan includes two tranches: $375 million for six years and $375 million for eight years, both available for multiple draws over a one-year window. The loans rank pari passu with existing borrowings and are guaranteed by certain subsidiaries. Proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes, including funding a portion of the cash consideration for the planned JRD Acquisition.
: $750 million senior unsecured delayed draw term loan facility (6-year and 8-year tranches)
: CoBank; Bank of America (administrative agent); and other lenders
: Finance JRD Acquisition and general corporate purposes
